verdict.rationale: First-party pricing and docs state the product can be self-hosted on your own infrastructure, including free Docker self-hosting, on-premise enterprise deployment, and a desktop app that runs entirely on your computer. A public GitHub repo, release notes on Kubernetes probes, and community reports of customized enterprise deployments and local desktop installs corroborate this. Missing for 10: in-depth self-hosting/Docker deployment documentation in the pack, explicit license terms confirming openness of the core.
